name: clyde
description: Shared memory for AI agents across Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini, Antigravity, and Grok, with files and a quest board on paid plans.

interface.shortDescription: Shared memory across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and Gemini
interface.longDescription: Agents forget everything when a chat ends. Save a decision, preference, or note in Claude, Gemini, or Antigravity, and recall it later in ChatGPT or Codex with its source and confidence. Paid plans add file attachments and a shared quest board for handing off work. Use Clyde for normal work context, never passwords or secrets.
defaultPrompt: Check Clyde for past decisions and notes on this project
Check my Clyde inbox and open quests
Save this decision to Clyde for my other agents
